verdict.rationale: Direct probes found no agent-oriented documentation: https://launchdarkly.com/llms.txt and https://launchdarkly.com/docs.md both returned HTTP 404, and no pack item documents llms.txt, markdown docs, or other agent-readable doc formats. The official MCP server and CLI belong to separate stories and do not count as agent-oriented docs. Confidence is medium because the probes only checked the root domain, not paths such as /docs/llms.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
